name: Summit AZ - Website Tracker Sheet Data
body:
> Tracker · Summit Az · 2026-06-23

# Summary
Data and build scripts behind the Summit AZ website tracker workbook (`build_workbook.py` writes `Summit-AZ-Website-Tracker.xlsx` to the root folder; the workbook itself is a root file covered on the hub side). Snapshot from mid to late June 2026.

# Key facts
- `combined.csv` (159 rows): Service Page (City) 120, Service Page (General) 23, Core Page 6, Blog Post 5, Landing Page (PPC) 3, Legal 2. Columns: type, service or category, city, title, URL.
- `pages.csv` / `pages_live.csv`: about 155 published pages with IDs and post dates (newest: `/blog` page 2026-06-18, Queen Creek water heater and Scottsdale leak detection pages 2026-06-17).
- `posts_live.csv`: the 9 posts live by 2026-06-22 (IDs 5779 to 5830). `blogs.csv`: the first 5 posts with categories (Drains and Sewers, Water Heaters, Leaks and Pipes).
- `ssh_err.txt`: a failed WP-CLI run (wrong path, not a WordPress install). `e1.txt` and `e2.txt` are empty.

# Prestige flag
`build_prestige.py` and `add_prestige_blog_calendar.py` in this folder build the Prestige Plumbing website tracker (`Prestige-Plumbing-Website-Tracker.xlsx` at the root) and add a blog calendar. They are Prestige work, not Summit. See [Prestige Plumbing (Hub)](lib:brain-prestige-plumbing-hub).
